Welcome to Day 2 of the UDS Summer Invitational in Kansas City, Missouri! After 8 Swiss rounds of intense Dueling, the best 32 Duelists have advanced to today’s portion of the event. Here they have an additional 4 rounds of Swiss, followed by a final cut to the Top 8!

Sky Strikers and Gouki are the two big contenders in the tournament, although we are seeing a huge variety in each individual strategy. Sky Strikers are being mixed with Invoked, Trickstars, Mekk-Knights, and in pure builds. Gouki are being played as their normal combo variants, or with DARK focuses, and there’s even one Phantom Knight build! Besides all those, we also have True Draco, Paleozoic, and Mekk-Knight Invoked Decks represented in the remaining Duelists.
